data.deep: An indexer keeps track of what has been posted and where. lemonfiber asks yours whenever something is wanted; without one, nothing can be found to download, however much else is configured. The bundled indexer aggregator lists Usenet indexers and torrent sites together under the one word, which is why one screen holds both. A torrent site is often called a tracker after the part of it that introduces peers to each other, and on a private one that same part is what watches your ratio — so the two words overlap without meaning the same thing.
data.short: Search engines that find what you are looking for. You need at least one, and most cost a small yearly fee.
